text:
Samir: Heads up — after the kernel roll in us-west-2 last night a subset of GPU nodes started failing NCCL allreduce. Initial trace shows module ABI mismatch between nvidia-driver-535 and kernel 6.1.12 on our 3090/4090 pool.
DeployBot: [rollback] kernel-6.1.12 -> kernel-6.1.11 triggered on affected autoscale group (asg-gpu-west-2-3090).
Tara: Oof. Is this a DKMS/module rebuild failure or a deeper driver <-> CUDA runtime incompat?
Samir: Looks like dkms built modules but symbols differ; nccl communication fails intermittently (timeouts + hang). CUDA runtimes (11.8/12.1) unaffected at user space, but drivers export different kernel symbols.
Juniper: We need an immediate package-pinning hotfix + a longer lockstep matrix. Short-term: pin drivers and kernel on production GPU pools until we validate.
Devon: Agreed. Hotfix commands I ran in staging (Ubuntu):
```
# hold nvidia driver and kernel packages
sudo apt-mark hold nvidia-driver-535 nvidia-kernel-source-535 linux-image-6.1.11-200
# verify
apt policy nvidia-driver-535
```
For RHEL nodes: `yum versionlock add kernel-6.1.11-200 nvidia-driver-535*`
Juniper: Also add an APT preference file to prevent auto-upgrade and update our image build to pin kernel/toolchains. I'll draft cookbooks.
Tara: We should also gate future kernel/driver rollouts with a compatibility matrix: driver version x kernel minor x CUDA minor x NCCL patch. If any cell is untested, the rollout must be blocked.
Samir: Proposal: create a lockstep matrix doc in infra-runbook: columns: gpu-driver, kernel, cuda, nccl, dkms-ok (Y/N), tested-on (instance type), notes. Add grid checks to the rollout pipeline.
Devon: Immediate rollout plan: 1) Apply apt-mark holds on all affected ASGs (us-west-2 gpu pool), 2) schedule canary upgrade rollback to stable image in us-east-1 (4 nodes ~10% traffic), 3) run nccl/sharded allreduce test harness for 6 hours, 4) if <0.5% error, roll to remaining nodes.
Juniper: Also add a version-gate to the provisioning service: when creating new GPU nodes, enforce that driver+kernel combo exists in the compatibility matrix. Fail provisioning with clear error if not.
Tara: Heads-up on impact: pinning will block the new kernel which had perf gains for some new ML jobs. Cost/throughput tradeoff — we should notify customers on Dedicated.
Samir: I'll open an incident postmortem draft and include affected job IDs, error logs, and the hotfix checklist. OpsBot: created ticket INFRA-732 - "nvidia/kernel compatibility + gating" and assigned to infra-runbook.
DeployBot: Canary rollback scheduled 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z; watch channel #eng-infra for telemetry.
Devon: After we stabilize, we should automate package-hold cleanup with a manual approval step and a migration test plan.
Samir: Thanks everyone. Juniper/Tara — please own the compatibility matrix and gating PR. I'll handle the postmortem and immediate holds across regions.
Juniper: On it — will push a draft matrix and a puppet/ansible snippet by EOD. :thumbsup:
